subject: [enc4k] payload-vcodec-q staged (H.264 quality bisect, 7 sessions, one boot); payload-vcodec-lvl staged; vcodecd auto-level done (IP 1040/1040)
body: payload-vcodec-q: vcodecd c5e750bb (vc16/vc18 daemon) + probe fc604f39 (--then entries now CODEC:WxH:FRAMES:FPS:PROFILE:LEVEL). Sessions, all H.264 at vcodecd bitrate w*h*4: 0 1920x1080 Baseline L4.1; 1 1920x480 Baseline (width test); 2 640x1080 Baseline (height test); 3 1280x720 Baseline; 4 640x480 Baseline (vc14 control); 5 1920x1080 Main 4.1; 6 1920x1080 High 4.1 (profiles last: a refused profile may poison the guest). All same codec, so the H.264->HEVC switch failure of vc18 does not apply. Command: PAYLOAD=payload-vcodec-q GUEST=guest-vcodec.sh OWNED=$W/gpu/build/apps-20261104/owned-vcodec.json timeout 900 bash autocycle/txn.sh $IMG vc19-q. Host analysis so far of vc16 frame 0: per-MB QP 20-26 at 1080p (VGA vc14: 31-32) yet PSNR 27 vs 48 dB, no spatial shift/gain error, errors are per-cell DC/column offsets copied down by vertical prediction: the encoder spends ~4.7 B/MB at LOW QP, i.e. residual is not where it should be -> suspect an encoder-side reconstruction/prediction mismatch (line buffer / neighbour data) at large widths rather than rate control; the width/height bisect answers it. payload-vcodec-lvl: vcodecd 79c6004d (current tree incl. decoder service behind --decoder, off; auto level for OPEN.level 0) + probe ff8348ce ladder with --level -1.
